about_the_game:
Delve dungeons, craft items and build relationships as you work to recover your memory and defend your new home. Bher is a town under siege, and you are an amnesiac with nothing to your name but a severe injury. Search the local woods and caves for resources and craft powerful weapons to delve deeper into infested mines and forgotten swamps; strengthen your relationships with your neighbours to earn formidable companions, and take care of your plants and animals to receive rewards that will no doubt aid in your quest to recover your memory and stem the flow of destruction that threatens Bher.

 A 1-bit life sim ARPG experience in a gothic setting. Featuring 5 skill lines, including fishing; crafting; 6 available companions with romance and friendship storylines; 5 dungeons to delve, and hours of fighting-crafting-talking gameplay.
